history.created_by: RUN |2 SOURCE_PACKAGE=libxml2 EXPECTED_VERSION=2.9.10+dfsg-5ubuntu0.20.04.10 /bin/sh -c set -eu;     case "$SOURCE_PACKAGE" in       libxml2) binaries="libxml2 libxml2-utils" ;;       libarchive) binaries="libarchive13 libarchive-tools" ;;       *) echo "Unsupported source package" >&2; exit 1 ;;     esac;     apt-get update;     apt-get -y dist-upgrade;     for binary in $binaries; do       candidate="$(apt-cache policy "$binary" | awk '/Candidate:/ {print $2}')";       test "$candidate" = "$EXPECTED_VERSION" || {         echo "Public candidate changed for $binary: $candidate (expected $EXPECTED_VERSION); refresh preflight, do not downgrade." >&2;         exit 1;       };     done;     for binary in $binaries; do apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends "$binary=$EXPECTED_VERSION"; done;     dpkg-query -W libxml2 libarchive13 2>/dev/null || true;     rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* # buildkit
